isns.description: iSNS server configuration parameters based on open-isns-server documentation (isnsd.conf). Note: The provided documentation source for this review was erroneous (referencing OpenOffice). This correction relies on standard `open-isns-server` (isnsd) documentation. Fields not present in standard `isnsd.conf` (such as max_portals, max_nodes, heartbeat_interval, discovery_domains_enabled, and cluster_name) have been removed as they are not part of the authoritative configuration schema for this service. The standard port for iSNS is TCP/3205, not UDP. Defaults are retained where they align with common practice or standard documentation for isnsd, while explicitly incorrect types (e.g., UDP port) and non-existent directives are fixed or removed.
